        # approximate by scanning ascii region of node's boundary

                    coords.append((r,c))

# prepare actions list (limit to first 10 for now)
actions=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for r,c in coords[:10]]
print('sample actions',actions)
# execute them
action(actions)
